MAKE IT YOURS

How invitations and replies work.

This page explains the feature. Create an account to manage your real guest list, private invitations and replies.

01

Build a guest list that works for your wedding

Group guests by household, family or whatever makes sense to you. Keep notes about dietary requirements and table or seating arrangements beside their details.

02

Share an invitation link

Choose who a guest can reply for and share the invitation through the channel that suits you. Mark invitations as already sent so you know where things stand.

03

See the replies come together

Track attendance and guest responses from your couple dashboard. Check outstanding replies before confirming final numbers with your venue and suppliers.

04

Keep the personal details personal

Guest lists and invitation links are part of your private planning. This public page explains the tools without showing any real guest information.
